scope.description: Exact deep dossier enrichment for Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation and LEUNR, preserving all research, Review and Publish boundaries.

source.title: Corporations Canada record for Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation
source.locator: Corporation 1252078-8, status, name history, director, ISC and annual-return notices
source.summary: Federal record confirms 2020 incorporation, current Active status, the 2025 name change, one listed director and ISC, and overdue annual filings with a notice of intent to dissolve.

leads.evidenceLocator: Corporations Canada; OECD-NEA pages 117-118; CSA, DND and NRC agreements; ERA, UAlberta, NGen, NATO DIANA, Telesat and FedDev records; attributed Canadian Explorers interview
followUpQuestions: Which CNSC pre-licensing, licensing, environmental-review and site milestones govern the first fueled LEUNR demonstration?
Which qualified HALEU fuel design, supplier, reservation and fabrication pathway supports the first fueled LEUNR core?
Which current thermal and electric rating, fuel, coolant, mass, transport, refuelling and heat-rejection baseline should a buyer evaluate?
How do 2028 criticality, 2029 demonstration and 2029-2030 Arctic deployment depend on licensing, fuel, siting, prototype evidence and corporate filing remediation?
reviewWarnings: Corporations Canada lists CSMC as Active but flags two consecutive overdue annual filings and a notice of intent to dissolve; recheck immediately before any publication decision.
No reviewed public source establishes a CNSC vendor design review, licence application, approved site, environmental review, fueled criticality or operating reactor for CSMC or LEUNR.
CSA describes TRL 4/5 conceptual design moving toward TRL 6 detailed design; a company-stated July 2026 TRL 5 deadline has no public completion proof.
The NRC IRAP record defines an unfuelled instrumentation-and-controls prototype objective but publishes no completion or acceptance result.
OECD-NEA's 0.1 MWth, 130 C and fuel parameters are a 2025 historical design basis and require confirmation before buyer use.
No public CSMC agreement establishes qualified HALEU supply, fuel fabrication, reservation or delivery.
Telesat's arrangement is an MOU; pilots and commercial or operational arrangements require definitive agreements.
NGen funds manufacturing-process and factory-cell development, not a proven serial line or tens-to-hundreds annual production capacity.
ERA and the University of Alberta describe an unfuelled prototype or physical simulator, not a fueled reactor, criticality event or licensed facility.
Public contributions and total-project values have different bases and are deliberately not aggregated as financing or revenue.
The Canadian Explorers article is an attributed CEO interview, not independent proof of size, transportability, refuelling interval, output, manufacturing capacity, financing or deployment.
No named Indigenous community, northern utility, defence installation or site owner is publicly established as a LEUNR customer, consent partner or deployment host.
A peer-reviewed CNL-authored paper raises lunar heat-rejection limits for low-temperature light-water concepts but does not test LEUNR or establish terrestrial Arctic infeasibility.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed CSMC's current official identity, subsidiaries, LEUNR expansion, stated 2029 demonstration target and public contact route.
Recovered the historical 0.1 MWth, 130 C, pressurized light-water and fuel design basis plus licensing, siting and fuel-supply limits.
Confirmed federal incorporation, Active status, name history, current ISC control and the time-sensitive overdue-filing and intent-to-dissolve warning.
Located a pending lunar and planetary reactor patent family but did not treat it as proof of the current LEUNR configuration, construction or performance.
Resolved CSA, DND, NRC and DIANA public agreements, including exact dates, amounts, identifiers and the unfuelled or early-stage maturity boundaries.
Confirmed no reported parent company, named subsidiary beneficiaries and disclosed federal funding without converting lobbying activity into customer demand.
Resolved Telesat, ERA, University of Alberta, NGen and NATO counterpart evidence while preserving MOU, unfuelled and development-stage limits.
Captured the supplied CEO interview as attributed timeline and design context, then excluded unsupported performance, deployment, fuel-supply and manufacturing claims.
Checked French Open Government and bilingual federal surfaces; they confirmed existing program scope but produced no additional decision-changing field.
Final CNSC, CNL, fuel-supplier, transport and customer searches found no public licence, siting record, qualified fuel agreement, deployment order or additional candidate field.
